design.privilege: installed LocalSystem service performs update; normal user sends only user-defined service control
design.source: GitHub latest release only; draft/prerelease rejected
design.integrity: GitHub asset sha256 digest == SHA256SUMS.txt == downloaded installer SHA256
design.transport: Windows curl.exe -L --fail with bounded connect/max time and retry
design.installPath: HKLM Inno Setup InstallLocation, fail-closed if expected app/manifest absent
design.completion: installer post-install writes action-status done/0 and deletes pending-update; service startup has secondary finalize guard

e2eUpgrade.actionHandoff: Verified v1.1.0; installing directly without UAC.
e2eUpgrade.note: Synthetic downgrade-in-version test exists only to exercise a real public release asset and silent privileged handoff; target v1.1 predates installer completion-marker logic.

failuresConvertedToRegression: SCM control 131 constant existed but Handler case was initially missing; contract now requires case CTRL_UPDATE and Task.Run(RunUpdateAsync).
Updater now preserves registered user InstallLocation explicitly through /DIR when run as LocalSystem.
Installer completion marker is independent of target service startup.
